remarks: Looking for a modern, move-in ready apartment in SONO?! Your search is over! Welcome to 33 N Water Street #701, this one bedroom corner unit offers a spacious open floor concept for a comfortable and completely customizable living space. The Maritime complex was built in 2007 and is located in the heart of SONO, a stones throw to several restaurants and shops, the SONO Collection shopping center, I-95, Metro North train station, beaches, and so much more. This unit comes complete with in unit washer dryer, stainless steel appliances, large walk in closet, balcony, and one designated garage parking spot located underneath the complex. This complex also has a common area game room and exercise room. Schedule your showing today! This unit will not be available for long!
